subject: Insight News — newsletter access pass allocation
messages:
From: Caroline Reed <caroline.reed@insightnews.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: insight-news-ops@insightnews.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo codes for July newsletter — request

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our partnerships desk. We’re planning a July 8 member newsletter (open rate ~28%) and would like to offer readers a trial access pass to Redwood Inference.

High level: 500 unique, single-use access passes to be distributed to subscribers. Ideally:
- 400 standard 30-day trial passes (access to hosted API quota)
- 100 developer-boost passes (extra tokens for longer eval)

Attached is an audience breakdown (audience_estimate.xlsx) — most recipients are product/eng leaders. We’d like co-branded landing + a promo code field for tracking. Can you confirm:
1) feasibility and timeline to generate codes
2) recommended trial length / token allotment for the developer-boost passes
3) any partner terms or DocuSign needed on your side

We aim to send the newsletter 2027-07-08, so would love to finalize by Friday (2027-06-18).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if easier.

Best,
Caroline Reed
Publisher Partnerships Manager
Insight News
[Attachment: audience_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Caroline Reed <caroline.reed@insightnews.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo codes for July newsletter — request

Hi Caroline — thanks for the request and the file. This is doable. Quick answers below and a couple of asks so Ops can scope correctly: 

1) Feasibility/timeline: Ops can generate 500 single-use codes and deliver a CSV within 48 hours once we lock the allocation. We can also create two code types (standard / dev-boost) with different entitlements.
2) Recommendation: standard = 30 days + 10k tokens; dev-boost = 90 days + 75k tokens (this preserves budget while giving engineers enough runway). We can adjust if you prefer shorter/longer.
3) Terms: we’ll need a short partner coop agreement (standard template attached). If that’s OK we’ll send a DocuSign.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa (partners) will confirm the tracking params and the landing URL.
- Vanessa (marketing ops) will open a code-gen request with Ops and share tracking tags.
- Once legal signs the coop we’ll hand off codes.

If you want a quick call today I can do 3pm PT.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: partner_coop_terms_template.pdf (pdf)]

Looping ops/finance notes and a proposed allocation below.

- 400 x standard (30d / 10k tokens)
- 100 x dev-boost (90d / 75k tokens)

Estimated unit cost (approx): standard = 0.35 USD equivalent per code; dev-boost = 1.80 USD equivalent per code. Total estimated promo budget ~ $6,700.

Ops asks: please use promo_codes_pool.csv as the delivery format with columns: code, entitlement_profile, expires_at, campaign_tag.
Tracking: add utm_source=insight_news&utm_campaign=july8_newsletter plus HubSpot campaign HS-45872. Grace — can you confirm the landing page and whether we need special UTM variations per cohort?

Marissa
